en.headline: Cyclist taken to hospital after taxi crash on Boundary Street
en.dek: A man riding a road bicycle was conscious when ambulance crews took him to Caritas Medical Centre after a collision with a taxi.
body: A taxi and a road bicycle collided at about 3.13am on Wednesday at the junction of Boundary Street and Sai Yeung Choi Street North, according to accounts carried by local media.
The cyclist fell and was injured. Ambulance crews found him conscious, treated him at the scene and took him to Caritas Medical Centre. One report described the injuries as minor.

The taxi driver was allowed to drive away after inquiries, and police said they were investigating how the crash happened. One report said the driver had passed a breath test; that detail was not repeated in every account.

zh.headline: 界限街的士與公路單車相撞 單車男清醒送院
zh.dek: 凌晨一輛的士在西洋菜北街與界限街交界撞倒單車，騎手清醒，由救護車送往明愛醫院。
body: 本地傳媒引述消息稱，周三凌晨約3時13分，一輛的士沿西洋菜北街駛出界限街時，與一輛沿界限街行駛的公路單車相撞。
單車男倒地受傷。救護人員到場時他保持清醒，經即場治理後送往明愛醫院。有報道形容他傷勢輕微。
涉事的士司機在調查後獲准駛離現場，警方正調查意外原因。有報道稱司機已通過酒精呼氣測試，但並非所有報道都提及這項細節。
